description: Reference dashboard for NVKE node provisioning duration (p50/p95/p99), teardown, terminal success vs give-up rate, and currently in-progress nodes. Not deployed by nke-stack.

options.content:
### Scope
Reference dashboard for NVKE node provisioning duration, terminal success vs give-up rate, teardown, and currently in-progress nodes. It is not deployed by nke-stack. Import this JSON and select a Prometheus datasource scraping the NVKE controller `/metrics` endpoint.

Queries use the NVKE controller metrics with the `nvke_controller_*` prefix. Filter variables are the labels the controller emits: `$tenant_cluster` and `$node_type`. Scrapes sometimes add a `k8s_cluster_name` label for the site-controller cluster that runs the controller; this dashboard does not require it. To join these series with kube-state-metrics on a `k8s_cluster_name` board, rewrite the label: `label_replace(nvke_controller_node_info{tenant_cluster=~"$tenant_cluster"}, "k8s_cluster_name", "$1", "tenant_cluster", "(.*)")`.

### How to read outcomes
`nvke_controller_node_provision_total{result="failure"}` counts **Temporal attempts**, not failed nodes. A stuck node with unlimited retries inflates that counter. Terminal outcomes are **successes** vs **give-ups** (`nvke_controller_node_provisioning_giveups_total`: recycled after `NODE_PROVISIONING_TIMEOUT`, default 2h). Success rate = successes ÷ (successes + give-ups).

Give-up series use `cluster_name` for the tenant cluster; the `$tenant_cluster` variable filters that label in give-up queries. Give-ups have no `node_type` label. With a specific `$node_type` selected, the success-rate panel combines successes for that type with give-ups across all types; select All node types for an all-types rate.

### In-progress nodes
`nvke_controller_node_lifecycle_elapsed_seconds{state="provisioning"}` is a DB-backed gauge: seconds since the node entered provisioning. Pending (not yet claimed) uses `nvke_controller_node_pool_pending_count`.

### Phases (current controller)
`capi_create`, `capi_ready`, `host_preparation`, `reboot`, `join`, `post_join`. Older fleet dashboards may still show `forge_ready`. Join p95 has a 300s threshold line (KubeadmJoin StartToClose ceiling).

### Teardown
`nvke_controller_node_teardown_duration_seconds` and `nvke_controller_node_teardown_total`. Recycle path is give-up → teardown → re-provision.

Queries match both the `nvke_controller_*` series and the `nke_controller_*` series a controller emitted before the rename, so the panels stay continuous across the cutover. The legacy half is removed in v0.25.0, once Mimir retention has aged out the `nke_controller_*` series; dropping it earlier costs these panels their pre-cutover history.

panels.title: Pending nodes (pool)
panels.description: nvke_controller_node_pool_pending_count — nodes not yet in the provisioning workflow.

panels.title: Longest time in provisioning
panels.description: Max elapsed seconds among nodes currently in state=provisioning.

panels.title: Marked for recycling
panels.description: Nodes currently in state=markedForRecycling on the lifecycle gauge.

panels.title: Provisioning nodes (elapsed)
panels.description: Each series is one node. Empty when nothing is provisioning.

panels.title: In-progress count over time
panels.description: count() of lifecycle gauges. Pending is a pool-level counter, not per-node elapsed.

panels.title: Provisioning success rate (vs give-ups)
panels.description: Successes ÷ (successes + terminal give-ups), not success/(success+failure). For a selected node type, successes are filtered but give-ups include all types. Select All node types for an all-types rate. No data means no provisioning in range.

targets.expr: (sum(increase({__name__=~"nke_controller_node_provision_total|nvke_controller_node_provision_total", result="success", tenant_cluster=~"$tenant_cluster", node_type=~"$node_type"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / ((sum(increase({__name__=~"nke_controller_node_provision_total|nvke_controller_node_provision_total", result="success", tenant_cluster=~"$tenant_cluster", node_type=~"$node_type"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase({__name__=~"nke_controller_node_provisioning_giveups_total|nvke_controller_node_provisioning_giveups_total", cluster_name=~"$tenant_cluster"}[$__range])) or vector(0)))

panels.title: Give-ups (recycled after timeout)
panels.description: Terminal failure: recycled after NODE_PROVISIONING_TIMEOUT. Filtered by cluster_name=~$tenant_cluster. Renders 0 when none.

panels.title: Failed ATTEMPTS (retries, not nodes)
panels.description: Per-attempt failure counter. One stuck node retrying swamps this. Use give-ups for terminal failures.

panels.title: Throughput — successes vs give-ups (per hour)
panels.description: Terminal outcomes over time. Fail-attempt rate is omitted so retry churn does not hide give-ups.

panels.title: All provision phases (p95 overlay)
panels.description: Where time goes at p95. Phases from the current controller workflow.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate({__name__=~"nke_controller_node_provision_phase_duration_seconds_bucket|nvke_controller_node_provision_phase_duration_seconds_bucket", tenant_cluster=~"$tenant_cluster", node_type=~"$node_type", phase="capi_create"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate({__name__=~"nke_controller_node_provision_phase_duration_seconds_bucket|nvke_controller_node_provision_phase_duration_seconds_bucket", tenant_cluster=~"$tenant_cluster", node_type=~"$node_type", phase="capi_ready"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate({__name__=~"nke_controller_node_provision_phase_duration_seconds_bucket|nvke_controller_node_provision_phase_duration_seconds_bucket", tenant_cluster=~"$tenant_cluster", node_type=~"$node_type", phase="reboot"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate({__name__=~"nke_controller_node_provision_phase_duration_seconds_bucket|nvke_controller_node_provision_phase_duration_seconds_bucket", tenant_cluster=~"$tenant_cluster", node_type=~"$node_type", phase="join"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate({__name__=~"nke_controller_node_provision_phase_duration_seconds_bucket|nvke_controller_node_provision_phase_duration_seconds_bucket", tenant_cluster=~"$tenant_cluster", node_type=~"$node_type", phase="post_join"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate({__name__=~"nke_controller_node_provision_phase_duration_seconds_bucket|nvke_controller_node_provision_phase_duration_seconds_bucket", tenant_cluster=~"$tenant_cluster", node_type=~"$node_type", phase="join"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate({__name__=~"nke_controller_node_provision_phase_duration_seconds_bucket|nvke_controller_node_provision_phase_duration_seconds_bucket", tenant_cluster=~"$tenant_cluster", node_type=~"$node_type", phase="join"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate({__name__=~"nke_controller_node_provision_phase_duration_seconds_bucket|nvke_controller_node_provision_phase_duration_seconds_bucket", tenant_cluster=~"$tenant_cluster", node_type=~"$node_type", phase="join"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Average time per phase (current selection)
panels.description: sum/count of the phase histogram over the dashboard range.

targets.expr: sum by (phase) (rate({__name__=~"nke_controller_node_provision_phase_duration_seconds_sum|nvke_controller_node_provision_phase_duration_seconds_sum", tenant_cluster=~"$tenant_cluster", node_type=~"$node_type"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum by (phase) (rate({__name__=~"nke_controller_node_provision_phase_duration_seconds_count|nvke_controller_node_provision_phase_duration_seconds_count", tenant_cluster=~"$tenant_cluster", node_type=~"$node_type"}[$__range])), 1)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate({__name__=~"nke_controller_node_teardown_phase_duration_seconds_bucket|nvke_controller_node_teardown_phase_duration_seconds_bucket", tenant_cluster=~"$tenant_cluster", node_type=~"$node_type", phase="capi_delete"}[$__rate_interval])))
